metadata.sourceHashScope: tracked live harness, API source, contracts source, package manifest and lockfile

privacy.note: Harness rejects unapproved queries before dispatch; a boundary stop is counted separately from actual exposure.

scope: Ten purposive nonrepresentative low-stakes manual cases; seven ordinary complete public claims, one mixed synthetic private/public, one personal preference and one incomplete fragment. Eight eligible facts balanced four true/four false.

semanticActionConfusion.interpretation: Semantic action and terminal event type determine scoring. Wire admissionAction uses wait/skip/check only; needs_confirmation terminal plus skip means clarification with verification stopped. No extra failures are assigned for those payload values.

citations.openingMethod: Independent connected Exa fetch returning substantive page content; may use index/cache, not a direct-origin freshness guarantee.
citations.independence: Five relevant citations are not five independent origins; source overlap documented in sealed review.

sourceFreezeVerification.runnerSourceHashScope: tracked live harness, API source, contracts source, package manifest and lockfile

methodology.authorshipIsolation: Author read repository policy only before authoring and sealing. Later integration reads of the requested frozen harness exposed its inline development examples after sealing; no sealed inputs or labels changed. No original heldout fixture was inspected.
methodology.groundTruthSourceQualification: Authoritative first-party institutional/operator publications were used for ground truth; science references are original institutional educational publications, not original experimental research.

limitations: This small purposive nonrepresentative sample does not estimate production accuracy.
Only 2/8 eligible facts were resolved correctly and definitively (25%); this is not a successful coverage result.
Conditional precision 2/2 is based on two outputs, with five abstentions and one no-verdict excluded from that denominator; neither abstention nor clarification passes factual correctness.
All ten requests had terminal feedback. Seven factual results retained presentation and all seven responded; non-result presentation fields were not retained, so silence cannot be inferred.

Zero forbidden search-query exposure is observed with a harness that blocks unapproved queries before dispatch; authorized classification receives the submitted input, using synthetic private data in the mixed control.
Five sources were opened through connected Exa and may be index/cache backed. Relevant citations overlap and are not five independent confirmations.
Known cost is partial: 22 Jev attempts lack reported cost. Token usage was measured, with zero remaining unknown usage reservations.
Input-token reservations are stopping allowances, not guaranteed upper bounds; actual requests can exceed reservations before a stop.
Automatic notification, native/iOS and ASR paths were not evaluated.
Progress checkpoint records retain completed:false even at final phase; the preserved final campaign report records completed:true and all ten terminal receipts.

No hardware benchmark or listening false-alert inference; small sequential manual sample. Cold/cached flags apply to retained factual result events, not clarification events. Source URL openings by the reviewer are independent validation, not deliberate user opens.

retentionArchive.publication: Private user retention only; contains sealed case material and must remain outside the PR.

publicDisclosure: Aggregate-only: no case bodies, labels or identifying source URLs. Detailed reports, journal, ground truth and reviews remain sealed outside the repository.

allTypedRequests.p95Method: Nearest rank: sorted durations at ceil(0.95*n); for n<=10 this is maximum. Median averages middle pair for even n.
